name: T3EX Global Holdings Corp.
summary: T3EX Global Holdings Corp., an investment holding company, provides integrated logistics services in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, East Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Sea Export and Air Export segments. It offers international freight forwarding services, such as ocean and air freight services.
